svg.title: The negotiating room, nine hours in
svg.desc: A newspaper negotiating room with a draft contract, a redline in four colours, a side letter face down, a flip chart in two columns and an untouched plate of sandwiches.

g.text: The negotiating room, nine hours in
Twelve things to find. Two of them are the same document and one has been signed.
the claims log: three in nine years
the jug of water nobody has touched
the flip chart, two columns, one empty
